in_arabic.name: Pardees
in_arabic.long_meaning: Pardees هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic word ‘farasah’, meaning ‘to cover’ or ‘protect’. The name Pardees symbolizes the idea of growth, renewal, and protection. In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is said to have used the metaphor of a green leaf to describe the beauty and tranquility of paradise.
